correctness.rationale: The source Theorem 11 and Section 7 imply exact equivalence between antisquare-good configurations excluding two exceptional six-letter factors and an eight-forbidden-word shift. Proposition 18 and complementation show exceptions are nonperiodic countable shift orbits, carrying no invariant probability mass. The new proof gives all 20 admissible five-bit states, their disjoint two primitive ten-state components and complete adjacency table. Verified exact characteristic polynomial t^4(t^3+1)(t^3-t^2-1), exact symbolic digit-weight polynomial t^4(t^3+y)(t^3-t^2-y), and periodic trace vs direct enumeration through n=14. Matrix trace/determinant identity, primitive Perron–Frobenius theory and derivative of the weighted Perron root prove the infinite claims. The verifier proves the finite identities with exact arithmetic; the published infinite minimal-antisquare theorem is acknowledged as an imported mathematical lemma, not claimed checked by finite experimentation.

value.rationale: The full periodic orbit law N_n, primitive orbit formula, and classification of precisely two complementary ergodic maximal-entropy phases are natural quantitative invariants of the classical good-word shift. Their coexistence and unequal exact digit frequencies distinguish a genuine symmetry-breaking behavior that is not visible from the previously computed supergolden word-growth rate. The full infinite family is classified, including the complication of two exceptional nonperiodic orbits. This is more than reformatting a count table or a numerical sample.
